description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s lineage claims with its source records: optionally the claim with the sources it says the dataset draws from, the release license and its wording, read for fully traceable, complete lineage or end-to-end provenance; each source with its id, name, license by name or SPDX id, where it was obtained, when, its stated commercial terms and whether it asks for attribution; each transformation step in order with its id, name, the source or earlier step ids it reads, whether its code or run log is recorded and whether upstream terms travel with its output; and the output with the step or source the released dataset comes from and its license. The signed report gives every source with its license, origin, whether it feeds the release, whether the claim names it and its issues, every step with its inputs, any input nothing provides and whether it is recorded and carries terms, the chain with the release, whether it is reached, the sources reaching it, the release license and its terms and the wording found, and counts them, and names a broken lineage: a source the claim names with no record, a source feeding the release that the claim leaves out, a step reading input no source or earlier step provides, a release no step reaches, a source whose terms rule out commercial use behind a release that allows it, an attribution duty a step drops and traceability wording the chain does not hold; then steps with no recorded code or run log and sources no step reads, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No steps, an unstated source license or origin, an unstated record of a step, no claimed sources and no release license leave the lineage unverifiable. This traces one dataset from its sources: the sources behind a knowledge base are wever_knowledge-source-check and where stored memories came from is wever_memory-provenance-check. Verdict dataset_lineage_broken, dataset_lineage_partial, dataset_lineage_unverifiable or dataset_lineage_complete. POST /api/dataset-lineage-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.

license.description: The release license, name or SPDX id.

sources.description: Sources the dataset says it draws from.

text.description: Read for wording such as fully traceable or complete lineage.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

id.description: The step or source the released dataset comes from.

origin.description: Where it was obtained, such as a URL or a vendor.

inputs.description: Source or earlier step ids it reads.

license_carried.description: Whether upstream terms travel with its output.

recorded.description: Whether its code or run log is recorded.

name: wever_dataset-lineage-check
title: Dataset lineage check
